added.summary: A caption file's translations beside it (`narration.zh.srt`, `narration.pt-BR.srt` beside `narration.srt`, each with its own times) cook with the timeline, and the track says the one of the locale the player asked for (og.i18n.setLocale), its language's for a regional tag, else its own. `locale "zh" { captions "…" }` in a caption track names a translation kept elsewhere.
